attachments.origin_landmark: angle of the thyroid cartilage (the laryngeal cartilages are not modeled as skeletal elements in this pass -- approximated via the adjacent hyoid attachment region)
attachments.insertion_landmark: vocal process of the arytenoid cartilage and the vocal ligament

actions: makes fine local adjustments to the tension of individual parts of the vocal fold

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: The medial, deeper part of thyroarytenoid, lying within the vocal fold itself alongside the vocal ligament. Its fibres insert along the length of the ligament rather than only at its ends, which is what allows segmental rather than whole-fold tension change -- the basis of fine pitch control in singing.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
